tagline: 理光便携相机，1991 年发布
description: 理光于1991年推出的便携相机。配备Ricoh Lens 35mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度mechanical, 1/125s (fixed speed)。感光度manual setting, ISO 100 / 200 / 400。fixed-focus。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 35mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.英文简介: This camera should not be confused with Ricoh's 1960's scale focus focus viewfinder camera of the same name.
